received_holders.name: Michel Rocard
received_holders.note: Observed on 24 January 1990: decree no. 90-89 of that day opens 'Le Premier ministre,' and is signed 'MICHEL ROCARD'. Until 15 May 1991: the decree of that day ends, on the Government's resignation, the functions of 'M. Michel Rocard, Premier ministre'.
received_holders.uncertainty: No start: his appointment (1988) lies before the packet period and was not researched, so he is dated by an in-period attestation. The end rests on the decree ending the functions, signed 15 May 1991; the resignation letter of the same day is a separate claim, and the decree appointing his successor (whose text is not rendered) is never used as this end.

received_holders.uncertainty: No start: Légifrance's page for the appointment decree of 15 May 1991 renders no text and names nobody, and the composition decree's reference to 'le décret du 15 mai 1991 portant nomination du Premier ministre' does not name the appointee; pairing the two would infer a start, so neither is used. No end: the decree of 2 April 1992 ending her Government's functions (JORFTEXT000000539723) has no usable archive capture, and her successor's appointment of 2 April 1992 is never used as this end.
